hypothesis: A train-only linear ranker using dense similarity plus cheap lexical and code evidence can separate correct documents from dense top-50 hard negatives.
algorithm: LogisticRegression C=1.0, no intercept, symmetric pair differences, fixed seed 20260929; score and stably rerank dense top 50 only
training_source: First 300 TRAIN-only IDs selected by E017 seed/order, previously mined E017 dense top-20 negatives; no DEV or confirmation IDs
acceptance_rule: DEV delta NDCG@10 >= +0.005 and paired 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0; MRR@10 regression less than 0.005; Recall@1000 unchanged. Then confirmation delta NDCG@10 > 0 with paired 95% lower bound > 0 before TEST.
latency_budget: Report same E019 fixed-sample p50 and p95; meaningful cost is a tradeoff unless established threshold is violated
query_length_gate: 13/55 recoverable >512; 54/242 top-10 >512; enrichment 1.059 < 2, so query cleanup rejected before implementation
